mapper.update: UPDATE `task` t LEFT JOIN `task_assignee` ta ON ta.`task_id` = t.`id` AND ta.`user_id` = #{userId} SET t.`status` = 'COMPLETED', t.`completed_by` = #{userId}, t.`completed_at` = NOW(), t.`submit_content` = #{submitContent} WHERE t.`id` = #{taskId} AND t.`status` IN ('PENDING', 'EXPIRED') AND (t.`status` = 'PENDING' OR (t.`allow_late_submit` = 1 AND NOW() <= t.`late_deadline_at`)) AND (t.`task_type` = 'GLOBAL' OR ta.`id` IS NOT NULL)
UPDATE `task` SET `status` = 'CANCELLED', `cancelled_by` = #{cancelledBy}, `cancelled_at` = NOW(), `cancel_reason` = #{cancelReason} WHERE `id` = #{taskId} AND `status` IN ('PENDING', 'EXPIRED')
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM `task` WHERE `company_id` = #{companyId} ORDER BY `created_at` DESC

SELECT t.* FROM `task` t WHERE t.`company_id` = #{companyId} AND ( t.`visibility` = 'PUBLIC' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `task_viewer` tv WHERE tv.`task_id` = t.`id` AND tv.`user_id` = #{userId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `task_assignee` ta WHERE ta.`task_id` = t.`id` AND ta.`user_id` = #{userId}) ) AND ( (t.`task_type` = 'GLOBAL' AND t.`status` = 'PENDING' AND t.`deadline_at` > NOW()) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `task_assignee` ta2 WHERE ta2.`task_id` = t.`id` AND ta2.`user_id` = #{userId}) ) ORDER BY t.`created_at` DESC

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM `task` t WHERE t.`id` = #{taskId} AND (t.`visibility` = 'PUBLIC' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `task_viewer` tv WHERE tv.`task_id` = t.`id` AND tv.`user_id` = #{userId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `task_assignee` ta WHERE ta.`task_id` = t.`id` AND ta.`user_id` = #{userId})) )
